native_scope.name: Kvasir-v2
native_scope.split_note: The local San-D/Kvasir_V2 repository exposes one train split of 800 images (100 per class); it is not the model card's unreleased 480-image evaluation split.
native_scope.original_dataset_note: Kvasir-v2 is an 8-class endoscopy image dataset from Simula Research Laboratory.

dataset.index_source: native loader GT, materialized as classification_annotations.json in the native phase directory

limitations: Capture-ready is a code integration state, not a claim that inference has passed.
Unobserved native Top-5 is unavailable; aggregate scores are not predictions.

timing_alignment.forward: Same event/current-stream/synchronize semantics; wrapper preserves exactly one native call. MX runtime differs.
timing_alignment.e2e: Native DataLoader fetch to CPU prediction availability; worker-prefetch boundary differs from Example. Does not include subsequent metrics or record writes.
timing_alignment.model_load: Sum of measured native construction/load/placement blocks, not Example contiguous block.
timing_alignment.warmup: Native repeated preprocessed first batch; native count retained; synchronized before/after. Unlike Example, preprocessing/transfer/softmax-to-CPU are outside the warmup interval.
timing_alignment.evaluation: Native aggregate evaluation not measured separately; evaluation_seconds=null. Public scoring duration is outside native timing.
timing_alignment.resume: No resume; repeated native phase archives previous output; resume_segments=1.
